groups.definition: Strikes or work stoppages at major automaker customers (e.g., UAW strikes) reduce production volumes and demand for the company's products.

groups.canonical_name: Workforce labor strikes and work stoppages
groups.definition: Unionized or organizing workforces, collective bargaining disputes, or works council requirements may lead to strikes, work stoppages, or constraints that disrupt the company's own operations and raise costs.
